accessible_via.return: _from, _to, gene_symbol, pmid, study_parameters, phenotype_categories, source, source_url, class, method, files_filesets

_key.description: PharmGKB variant annotation ID and drug accession joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Document handle of the source node, in collection/key form.

_to.description: Document handle of the target node, in collection/key form.

gene_symbol.title: Gene Symbol
gene_symbol.description: HGNC symbols of the genes PharmGKB associates with this annotation.

study_parameters.title: Study Parameters
study_parameters.description: Study-level details attached to the annotation. Each entry has a study parameter ID, study type, case and control counts, p-value as reported, and biogeographical group. One annotation can have several entries when the paper reports more than one analysis.

study_type.title: Study Type
study_type.description: Type of study (e.g. cohort, case/control, trio)

study_cases.title: Study Cases
study_cases.description: Number of study cases. Stored as a string as provided by the source, may be empty

study_controls.title: Study Controls
study_controls.description: Number of study controls. Stored as a string as provided by the source, may be empty

p-value.title: P-Value
p-value.description: Reported p-value operator and number as a single string (e.g. "= 0.49"), not a float. Null when the source row is malformed

phenotype_categories.title: Phenotype Categories
phenotype_categories.description: PharmGKB phenotype category of the association.

enum_descriptions.Dosage: Association with the amount of drug administered.
enum_descriptions.Efficacy: Association with the therapeutic response to a drug.
enum_descriptions.Metabolism/PK: Association with drug metabolism or pharmacokinetics, including drug exposure and clearance.
enum_descriptions.Other: A phenotype outside the other listed pharmacogenomic categories.
enum_descriptions.PD: Pharmacodynamics: association with the biological effects of a drug.
enum_descriptions.Toxicity: Association with adverse or toxic effects of a drug.

name.title: Name
name.description: Directional human readable label for the relationship, _from to _to.

inverse_name.title: Inverse Name
inverse_name.description: Reversed directional human readable label for the relationship, _to to _from.
